episodes.title: I Left a Cult 4.5 Years Ago. This Is My Life Now.
episodes.description:
Four and a half years ago, I left the FLDS. 

Leaving was the hardest thing I had ever done. But I didn't realize that building a life afterward would become its own kind of journey. 

In this video, I'm introducing myself, sharing a little where I came from, what my life looks like now, and what it has been like figuring out who I am outside of the world I grew up in.

This is the beginning of a new chapter, and I'm still figuring out what that looks like. 

Welcome to my new life!
